notes: The scenario verifies the object-class subscription active-state transition for the complete adapter-configured attribute set. An initial passive subscription is queried, the same attribute set is resubscribed actively with the standard service, and a fresh standard MIM report must reflect active=true without losing attributes or changing the adapter-selected update-rate designator. The sequence exercises only the ordinary non-regional service.

requirements.statement: The federate first subscribes passively to every adapter-configured attribute in the selected object class, then invokes the same standard service for that same set with active=true. The standard MIM report must show active=true and preserve the full set and configured update-rate designator.

A fresh standard MIM subscription report identifies the subject class, reports the active indicator as true after the state transition, and contains exactly the complete adapter-configured attribute-handle list and unchanged update-rate designator.
